standard_prerequisites.use: Ring identifications S_(fg) = (S_(f))_(g) and the restriction maps between degree-zero parts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Chart openings inside Spec(S_(f))
standard_prerequisites.use: Every standard open of Spec(S_(f)) comes from a D_+(h) inside D_+(f).

standard_prerequisites.name: Point homeomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: The homeomorphism from D_+(f) to Spec(S_(f)).

standard_prerequisites.name: Sections over standard opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-proj-sheaves (same chapter, section-level display, not carded)
standard_prerequisites.use: Sections of O and of M-tilde over D_+(f) are S_(f) and M_(f).

core_obligations: On D_+(f): the section ring is S_(f) and the homeomorphism pulls standard opens D(g) back to D_+(h); the displayed chain S_(fg) = (S_(f))_(g) = sections of O over D(g) identifies the structure sheaf.
Hence D_+(f) is affine isomorphic to Spec(S_(f)) and Proj(S) is a scheme.
Mirror: M-tilde restricted to D_+(f) is the pullback of the tilde of M_(f), which shows M-tilde is quasi-coherent.
proof_roadmap: Compare the sheaves on a basis of the chart via the displayed ring chain, conclude affineness chartwise, then run the same template for M-tilde.
difficulty_reason: Chart-by-chart scheme structure through displayed ring identifications on a basis of affines; the tilde part mirrors the same template; fully displayed.
